text:
Rhea: Quick: we need a partner scope negotiation policy that includes a simple scoring rule so SEs can decide what to accept in a 14-day pilot. want one paragraph + checklist.
Jon: Agreed. SEs waste time debating. a numeric score (impact x urgency / effort) could help.
Kai: From PM: propose a 3-factor score: Product Impact (0-3), Customer Risk (0-2), Engineering Effort (1-4). Accept in-pilot if (Impact+Risk)/Effort >= 1.2 and not a legal/compliance blocker.
Fiona: Also include launch gates/success metrics so partners know what counts as success: usage > 500 MAUs or 10k generated tokens and no major safety incidents for 7 days.
Samir: Ops: if ask touches capacity or reserved pools mark as `capacity` and require 3-week runway. if it affects latency SLOs, add `latency:impact` flag.
Rhea: Love the formula. Add shorthand labels: `dp:score:##` where ## is the computed value, plus `dp:capacity`, `dp:legal`, `dp:latency`.
Jon: Also need a rollback window rule: any changes deployed as part of pilot must include a canary for 48h and an auto-rollback threshold (error rate >1% or p95 latency degrade >30%).
Kai: Put that in the intake checklist so SEs include monitoring query and rollback criteria in the ticket.
Fiona: Success criteria: list primary metric (adoption/usage), secondary metric (latency/cost), and quality (qual feedback + automated evals). require partner sign-off on metric definitions before we start dev work.
Samir: For credits: we only give credits when we explicitly bill engineering hours inside pilot window. require `credits_est_hours` field on ticket and product+finance signoff. finance-bot: credits > $2k need finance approval.
legal: Any change that modifies retention, access control, or model weights must be escalated and cannot be implemented during pilot until legal signs off. label `dp:legal` to block.
Rhea: Decision summary: scoring formula (Impact 0-3 + Risk 0-2)/Effort 1-4 threshold 1.2; ack within 48h; blockers or score >=1.2 -> attempt in-pilot if effort <=3w and no legal flags. capacity needs 3-week runway. credits only for in-pilot eng time with approvals. canary 48h + auto-rollback thresholds. partner must agree on success metrics before dev.
Jon: Ticket template changes: add fields `dp:score`, `dp:primary_metric`, `dp:rollback_criteria`, `dp:credits_est_hours`, `dp:ack_ts`. I'll open a PR with examples.
Kai: SE playbook: quick scoring cheat sheet + sample calculations for common asks (e.g., webhook change = Impact 2 Risk 0 Effort 1 -> (2+0)/1=2 -> in-pilot).
Fiona: I'll draft the partner-facing paragraph: short, clear, includes scoring note & canary rollback.
Samir: Ops will provide capacity checklist and latency test harness for canaries.
finance-bot: Note: include estimate and finance approval step in the intake when credits requested.
legal: Will produce a 2-line escalation matrix for retention/weights/access changes (by EOD).
deploy-bot: Reminder: any pilot deployment must include monitoring dashboards and an automated rollback job.
Rhea: Action items:
- Fiona: partner-facing paragraph + one-line scoring explainer (EOD).
- Jon: ticket PR + examples (tomorrow morning).
- Kai: SE cheat sheet and 3 sample calculations (tomorrow).
- Samir: capacity checklist + latency harness (2 business days).
- legal: escalation matrix (EOD).
- finance-bot: confirm approval flow and thresholds (tomorrow).
Rhea: We'll trial this scoring + rollback policy for next 4 pilots. If it moves decisions faster, we'll keep it. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
